text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has officially kicked off this
week, with King Halo
going through my
beach training program.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I think I've done enough practice
at the beach.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. ♪ I guess I'll have to enlighten
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A little bird told me about a top-secret,
first-rate training area used
by G1 racers!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There's supposedly a super advanced
course in the forest behind our
camp. I bet
you're unaware of it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Of course you're unaware, it's
not easy to come across this
info after all!
Even I was only able to find it thanks
to my internet sleuthing skills.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well,
a lot of posts did warn that amateurs
are in for a world full of
pain, but that
doesn't apply to me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll handle all the planning,
so don't worry!
Just follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although King Halo seems confident in her
choice...

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? King, are you really going to run
in the forest tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's a good idea?
I heard that
the course is kinda
questionable...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, no need to fret! As a first-rate
racer, I'll show you that I can
run any
course thrown at me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I feel uncertain. I better prepare some
supplies for tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the day arrives.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Good morning, Trainer! Today, I
grant you the honor of
accompanying me
as I put my perfect practice plan into
action!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I've prepared thoroughly for this moment.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I spent last night researching
everything I could about the course.
Every important
place has been marked on my phone's
map!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, we're in the digital age now. I
don't need anything else
when I've got
everything on my phone.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand,
it looks like you've still
got lots to learn. I don't
know why you
brought such a heavy backpack with you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as I don't have to carry any
excess luggage, I'm perfectly happy. All
right, let's not waste any more time here!
Follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo's adventure in the mountains
begins.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... running on this mountain trail is
exhausting. There are too
many uneven
areas and natural obstacles in the way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The roads aren't paved and the humidity is
way too high. I wonder
what temperature it
is right now... Ah, where's my cellphone—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! There's a b-b-bug!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: T-T-Trainer! Hurry up and do something!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm okay. This isn't enough to make me
give up. All right, let me
check the next
destination...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, did you happen to see my
phone anywhere?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
O-of course not!
I'm just asking a question!
A first-rate racer would
never lose her
phone...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come on, think... think... Aha!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That must be it! Trainer, remember the
place where that bug attacked
us? We
have to go back there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was at the second rest area.
Okay, that's a great start. I've got
everything under control. I just need to
check the GPS on my
phone...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —which I don't have!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm doing perfectly fine! This minor
setback isn't going to faze me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna find my phone, I'm gonna get
out of this forest, and I'm
gonna go back
to the camp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it's clear things are going
downhill. I unfold my map and
begin
marking down the places we've been.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, what could you possibly be doing
right now?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is that a map and a compass in your
hands? And that red line...
is that the road
we've taken so far?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, that's amazing, Trainer! With
this, I'll be able to find
my—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Nngh... Yes... please...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, we managed to return in one
piece...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not a single scratch on me, or my
phone...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But, I'm surprised by how much
preparation you were able to do in such a
short amount of time. I told you about the
course only
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't let that get to your head. But
I admit, it was my fault this
time. I didn't
do nearly enough planning.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't brought that map and
compass with you, we would've
probably
found ourselves in an even bigger mess.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So I'm...
sorry for putting you through all
of that.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Since today's special,
I'll give you a bit of praise. You've
demonstrated traits worthy
of being with a first-rate racer such as 
myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we should review what we did
today and prepare for
tomorrow's forest
training. This time it'll be perfect.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Who do you think I am? Words
like "impossible" and "give
up" don't exist
in my dictionary!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry and go back to the camp now!
A first-rate trainer wouldn't
dream of
making me wait, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning, we immediately begin
devising a strategy for
tomorrow's
excursion.
